first.rationale: Shorter onboarding directly addresses the 4% completion decline and may also recover activation through faster time-to-value. Verify it against activation messaging, while checking whether either intervention improved downstream qualified revenue rather than only early engagement. Promotional pricing is responsive to the competitive threat but carries greater margin and customer-quality risk.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding. The verified record shows the strongest sustainable downstream signal: completion +13%, time-to-value improved by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention +3%. It directly addresses the current onboarding decline and can support activation through faster value realization. Activation messaging is a credible alternative with stronger direct activation lift, but its smaller retention gain makes it less compelling for long-term qualified revenue. Measure qualified conversion and retained revenue because neither archive establishes a direct long-term revenue effect.
